sample_unit: synthetic physician dialogues (nine scenarios) rated by five physicians
unlisted_practices: Using de-identified case metadata with structured prompting to generate synthetic physician-to-physician dialogues as a privacy-preserving alternative to real clinical conversation data
Physician panel rating of synthetic dialogues for communication effectiveness, medical content quality, and clinical relevance

screen.reason: The paper introduces and empirically evaluates an LLM-based framework (SynDocDis) for generating synthetic physician-physician clinical discussions via expert clinician review, but does not test a specific operational deployment guardrail or practice.
